desc: Fetch a canvas attached to a code channel.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing the `code_channels:manage` scope. Must be a granular bot token.

channel.desc: ID of the agent session channel the canvas belongs to.

canvas_id.desc: Encoded ID of the canvas to fetch.

content_format.desc: Format to render the canvas content in. Defaults to markdown.

include_resolved.desc: Whether to include resolved comment threads in the response. Defaults to false.

canvas_id.desc: The encoded ID of the canvas.

content.desc: The full canvas content rendered in the requested content_format.

comments.desc: Comment threads on the canvas, ordered oldest first. Resolved threads are excluded unless include_resolved is true.

id.desc: Stable ID of the comment thread (the canvas annotation the comment is anchored to).

user_id.desc: Encoded ID of the user who wrote the comment.

quoted_text.desc: The highlighted canvas text the comment is anchored to, rendered as mrkdwn. Empty if the anchored text has since been deleted from the canvas.

is_resolved.desc: Whether the comment thread has been resolved.

replies.desc: Threaded replies to the comment, ordered oldest first. Capped to the most recent 100 replies; older replies are dropped first.

user_id.desc: Encoded ID of the user who wrote the reply.

has_more_replies.desc: True if the thread had more replies than the cap and older replies were dropped from the response.

has_more_comments.desc: True if the canvas had more comment threads than the cap and older threads were dropped from the response.

channel_not_found.desc: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.

not_agent_channel.desc: The specified channel is not an agent session channel.

not_authorized.desc: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.

canvas_not_found.desc: The specified `canvas_id` does not correspond to a canvas you can access.

canvas_content_fetch_failed.desc: The canvas content could not be fetched or rendered.

comments_fetch_failed.desc: The canvas comment threads could not be fetched.
